title: WF03 OBS-03 QueryFailed rerun blocker: immutable audit fixture IDs caused duplicate-key failures
summary: TC-OBS-03-INT-04 and TC-OBS-03-INT-05 failed with PoolError.QueryFailed because fixtures inserted fixed audit_ids into immutable audit_entries; reruns hit duplicate primary keys. Tests were updated to use per-run UUIDs generated by PostgreSQL and deterministic timestamps for pagination ordering.

root_cause.details: OBS-03 integration tests inserted constant audit_id/resource_id/actor_id values into immutable audit_entries. Since rows cannot be deleted, subsequent runs attempted to reinsert existing primary keys and failed at INSERT with QueryFailed. After switching to per-run UUIDs, ordering assumptions in INT-05 also needed explicit timestamp offsets to avoid UUID tie-break variability.

changes: In tests/integration/obs03_audit_log_test.zig, replaced fixed UUID literals in TC-OBS-03-INT-04/05 with dbUuidString() generated IDs (SELECT gen_random_uuid()::text).
In tests/integration/obs03_audit_log_test.zig, made INT-05 ordering deterministic by using NOW()-2s and NOW()-1s timestamps for definition rows.
Re-ran required validations (zig build, zig build test, zig build test-integration-obs03, zig build test-integration) with report artifacts and explicit exit codes.

prevention: Do not use fixed primary keys in tests that write to immutable tables; generate run-unique IDs and scope assertions to those IDs.
When pagination order is validated, make ordering deterministic with explicit timestamp offsets instead of relying on UUID lexical tie-breaks.
